responsable.title: 1. Data controller
responsable.body: Adresse GN, a company based in Conakry (Republic of Guinea), determines and carries out the processing described on this page. This processing complies with law L/2016/037 on cybersecurity and personal data protection, as well as law L/2016/035 on electronic transactions.

account.title: 2.1 Account data
account.body: Email address, phone number, declared name and role (individual, professional, agent, administrator).

address.title: 2.2 Address and beacon data
address.body: Beacon number, GPS coordinates recorded during installation, accuracy of the reading, neighborhood and municipality, photo of the installed beacon, place label and possible category.

usage.title: 2.3 Usage data
usage.body: Searches performed, routes launched, reports filed, and technical logs necessary for the security of the service.

payment.title: 2.4 Payment data
payment.body: Order references, amounts and payment status. We do not store any complete banking data.

items.create: Create and maintain your digital address.
items.search: Enable address search by number and route generation.
items.planning: Plan and monitor beacon installation by our agents.
items.orders: Process your orders, payments and invoices.
items.fraud: Prevent fraud and misuse of the service.

visibilite.title: 4. Private and public addresses
visibilite.p1: A residential address is private by default: its owner does not appear anywhere publicly, and only someone who knows the beacon number can display the location.
visibilite.p2: A business listing (shop, hotel, service) is public when its owner publishes it: name, category, hours, photos and location then become viewable without an account.

partage.title: 5. Sharing with third parties
partage.body: We do not sell any data. We share only what is strictly necessary with our hosting, messaging and mobile payment providers, as well as with competent authorities upon legal request. Partners accessing our API only receive public addresses.

conservation.title: 6. Retention period
conservation.body: Address data is retained as long as the beacon is active. Account data is retained until the account is deleted. Accounting records and security logs are kept for the legal periods applicable in Guinea.

droits.title: 7. Your rights
droits.body: You have the right to access, rectify, object to, restrict and delete your data, as well as the right to withdraw your consent. You can also request correction of a GPS position or report a moved beacon from your customer area.

securite.title: 8. Security
securite.body: Access is authenticated and role-segregated, exchanges are encrypted in transit, photos and supporting documents are stored in private spaces, and every sensitive action is logged.

contact.title: 9. Contact us
